# Family Workstreams

**Machine-readable source:** `family-workstreams.yaml`

| ID | Workstream | Objective |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FW-01 | Family authority and governance | Maintain charter, invariants, canonical character identities, decisions, ADRs, statuses, and open questions. |
| FW-02 | Shared provisional contracts | Evolve manifest, envelope, permissions, completion, result reference, and import experiments. |
| FW-03 | Capability relationship and interoperability | Maintain result-consumption rules and relationship graphs. |
| FW-04 | Capability seed quality | Keep all ten project seeds coherent and implementation-generating. |
| FW-05 | Project-generation prompts | Evaluate prompts against fresh agents and produced packet quality. |
| FW-06 | Security and authority | Maintain family threat model and domain-specific authority prohibitions. |
| FW-07 | Agent Skills and portability | Maintain skill conventions, routing evals, and generated-adapter policy. |
| FW-08 | Evaluation and honesty | Maintain family claim-proof model, baselines, and result reporting discipline. |
| FW-09 | Research and licensing | Verify primary sources, licenses, and domain research agendas. |
| FW-10 | Packet integrity | Maintain validator, manifest, checksums, transcript coverage, and archive verification. |

## Coordination rule

Workstreams may proceed in parallel when they do not redefine shared semantics. Contract changes synchronize through FW-01/FW-02/FW-06. Capability-specific seed improvements should not be copied across all capabilities until the shared need is demonstrated.
